description: This source file defines the OpenIdApplicationStore class, which implements the IOpenIdApplicationStore interface for managing OpenID applications using YesSql as the data store. It includes methods for CRUD operations, querying, and property management of OpenID applications.

classes.name: OpenIdApplicationStore
classes.description: A generic class implementing application store operations for OpenID applications using YesSql.

methods.name: CountAsync
methods.description: Counts the number of applications in the store.

methods.name: CreateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new application record in the store.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes an application record from the store.

methods.name: FindByIdAsync
methods.description: Finds an application by its identifier.

methods.name: FindByClientIdAsync
methods.description: Finds an application by its client ID.

methods.name: FindByPhysicalIdAsync
methods.description: Finds an application by its physical ID.

methods.name: GetDisplayNamesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves display names in different cultures.

methods.name: GetJsonWebKeySetAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON Web Key Set.

methods.name: GetPermissionsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves permissions associated with the application.

methods.name: InstantiateAsync
methods.description: Creates a new instance of an application.

methods.name: ListAsync<TState, TResult>
methods.description: Lists applications based on a custom query; not supported.

methods.name: SetDisplayNamesAsync
methods.description: Sets display names in different cultures.

methods.name: SetJsonWebKeySetAsync
methods.description: Sets the JSON Web Key Set.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates an application record, handling concurrency.

methods.name: GetRolesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves roles associated with the application.

methods.name: ListInRoleAsync
methods.description: Lists applications in a specific role.
